summary.business_type: Professional Service / Agency (freelance web-dev & SEO, remote-first, no physical storefront)
top_findings: 19 /web-pro-* trade pages have zero images and no conversion path (no tel/WhatsApp/form/nav) despite being the site's largest page-type footprint
Today's internal-linking commit is mostly broken: template hubHref defaults to the wrong page, pillar only links to 4/19 spokes
Homepage LCP is 5.9s (Poor, lab-only) driven by one ~500KB JS chunk 64-82% unused
FAQ page: 8 of 9 answers exist only in JSON-LD, invisible to any crawler reading visible text
Content expansion is real but incomplete: only 3 of 18 trade pages got a full rewrite, 15 remain thin (323-345 words vs 800-word floor)
quick_wins: Fix MicroServicePage.tsx hubHref default (one line + 5 overrides)
Switch FAQ.tsx accordion from conditional render to CSS collapse (few hours)
Add tel/WhatsApp/contact link to web-pro-* page template
Add missing BlogPosting image/mainEntityOfPage fields using existing OG image

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt and sitemap.xml valid and correctly linked
SSR/SSG confirmed sitewide, no JS-rendering risk for crawlers
Zero duplicate titles across 48 pages, single H1 everywhere
HTTPS + HSTS enforced consistently

findings.title: www.vizeon.cz serves duplicate 200 instead of redirecting
findings.description: vercel.json defines a 301 redirect but live behavior contradicts it, likely a Vercel dashboard domain-alias override
findings.recommendation: Fix in Vercel dashboard (Project > Settings > Domains), not code

findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy header
findings.description: Confirmed absent across all sampled page types in next.config.mjs/vercel.json/middleware.ts
findings.recommendation: Add CSP via headers() in next.config.mjs

findings.title: Hero H1/H2 JS-gated via framer-motion
findings.description: Primary heading starts at opacity:0 and only paints after hydration + animation
findings.recommendation: Render hero heading at full opacity by default or use CSS-only animation

findings.title: Portfolio images 100% client-rendered on /ukazky-webu
findings.description: Zero tags in raw HTML on the page whose entire purpose is showing visual proof
findings.recommendation: Server-render at least the first 1-2 portfolio images

findings.title: noindex pages (/gdpr, /podminky) still listed in sitemap.xml
findings.description: Contradictory crawl signal
findings.recommendation: Remove from app/sitemap.ts, use /admin as template

findings.title: No IndexNow support
findings.description: No key file or submission call found
findings.recommendation: Implement IndexNow for faster Bing/Yandex indexing

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Genuine per-trade research on rewritten pages, not mail-merge filler
Transparent contact/legal info, no fabricated statistics detected
Testimonials use a verifiable named+linked format

findings.title: 15 of 18 web-pro-* pages remain under 800-word service-page floor
findings.description: 323-345 live words each, differentiated but thin
findings.recommendation: Prioritize full-page rewrites for highest-intent trades

findings.title: Blog articles are 240-333 words vs 1,500-word target
findings.description: Accurate, Czech-specific content but reads as extended FAQ not blog depth
findings.recommendation: Expand materially or relabel as guides/FAQ

findings.title: Repetitive 'not X, but Y' rhetorical pattern used 30x
findings.description: Classic AI-writing tic substituting for genuine depth
findings.recommendation: Vary sentence structure, human editing pass before publishing

findings.title: Named testimonials need owner verification
findings.description: 3 named+linked testimonials, stronger format than typical fake reviews but unverified
findings.recommendation: Confirm consent/authenticity for the record

findings.title: Founder anonymized on /o-mne
findings.description: Real name only in podminky/blog schema, not visible UI, undermining the 'one named person' pitch
findings.recommendation: Name founder on /o-mne and match blog byline to schema author

findings.title: /sluzby pages thin relative to 800-word floor
findings.description: 161-401 words across 12 pages
findings.recommendation: Expand highest commercial-intent pages first

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Zero duplicate titles across all 48 pages
Every page has a unique, non-empty meta description
Exactly one H1 per page sitewide

findings.title: A handful of titles/meta descriptions run long or short of ideal SERP length
findings.description: 4 titles exceed ~60-70 chars, 4 meta descriptions exceed 160 chars, several web-pro-* descriptions run short
findings.recommendation: Trim/pad to ideal ranges

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Service/FAQPage/BreadcrumbList present on all 19 web-pro-* pages and 12 sluzby pages
BlogPosting with author/publisher present on blog template
AggregateRating/GBP sameAs correctly deferred with TODO comments, no fabricated data

findings.title: Organization.logo points to 32x32 favicon
findings.description: Below Google's 112x112px minimum requirement
findings.recommendation: Create real square logo asset, min 512x512

findings.title: BlogPosting missing image, mainEntityOfPage, author.url
findings.description: A real per-post OG image already exists and can be reused with zero new assets
findings.recommendation: Add fields to app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx template

findings.title: Organization/ProfessionalService disconnected nodes
findings.description: No shared @id linking the two entity nodes in app/layout.tsx
findings.recommendation: Merge into one linked node

findings.title: FAQPage schema has no remaining SERP benefit
findings.description: Google retired FAQ rich results site-wide 2026-05-07
findings.recommendation: No action needed, don't prioritize more FAQ schema work

categories.name: Performance (lab-only, no CrUX)
what_works: CLS near-zero across all templates
next/image and next/font/google used correctly
Fast TTFB (140-409ms) on Vercel fra1

findings.title: Homepage LCP 5.9s (Poor)
findings.description: Driven by a single ~500KB JS chunk, 64% unused on homepage, blocking main thread before text-based LCP element paints
findings.recommendation: Code-split/lazy-load non-critical JS via next/dynamic

findings.title: Site-wide oversized shared JS bundle
findings.description: 30-82% unused per page across all three templates tested
findings.recommendation: Bundle analyzer + route-scope client components

findings.title: Render-blocking CSS on every page
findings.description: Two chunks ~150ms each in the critical path
findings.recommendation: Inline critical CSS, defer the rest

findings.title: Non-composited CSS animations
findings.description: Shimmer text and glow-pulse button force main-thread paint work
findings.recommendation: Re-implement with transform/opacity

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: AI crawlers fully allowed, no robots.txt or header blocks
Blog articles fully SSR with genuine named authorship and visible byline
Technical accessibility scores 90/100

findings.title: FAQ page: 8 of 9 answers invisible to text-reading crawlers
findings.description: Conditional React render instead of CSS collapse in components/FAQ.tsx
findings.recommendation: Switch to CSS-based collapse, single highest-leverage citability fix available

findings.title: Blog article sections run 60-120 words, under 134-167 optimal citation window
findings.description: Citable but slightly thin passages
findings.recommendation: Expand sections, rephrase some H2s as questions

findings.title: Brand-mention/authority signals near-zero
findings.description: Expected for a 14-week-old domain, not fixable on-page
findings.recommendation: No measurable AI-citation visibility expected for 6-12 months; off-site brand-building matters more than technical GEO work at this stage

categories.name: Images
what_works: next/image configured correctly (avif/webp, device sizing, CDN cache)
Descriptive, unique alt text where images exist

findings.title: Oversized original image assets in /public
findings.description: Several source originals over 1.4MB feeding the optimization pipeline
findings.recommendation: Pre-compress originals to under 500KB before committing

supplementary_audits.name: SXO / Conversion Readiness
supplementary_audits.note: Not part of the standard weighted formula, but measures whether pages actually convert visitors

findings.title: web-pro-* pages have zero images despite promising a gallery
findings.recommendation: Build the actual portfolio module described in the copy

findings.title: No conversion mechanism on trade pages
findings.recommendation: Add nav, tel/WhatsApp links, form

findings.title: Price positioning below SERP-consensus market range
findings.recommendation: Justify low anchor price or add tiered comparison

findings.title: /sluzby/seo-optimalizace thin relative to ranking competitors
findings.recommendation: Expand depth, add FAQPage schema

findings.title: Homepage H1 renders without word spaces
findings.recommendation: Fix animated per-word span component

supplementary_audits.name: Internal Linking / Cluster Architecture
supplementary_audits.note: Measures link-equity flow and hub-spoke structure, not content itself

findings.title: MicroServicePage hubHref defaults to wrong page
findings.recommendation: Fix default to point at the real pillar page

findings.title: Pillar page links to only 4 of 19 spokes
findings.recommendation: Expand pillar's linked trade index

findings.title: web-pro-autoservisy is a true orphan
findings.recommendation: Add reciprocal relatedSlugs links

findings.title: 8 of 19 spokes below 3-incoming-link minimum
findings.recommendation: Rebalance cross-link clusters

findings.title: Homepage cannibalizes two service-page titles
findings.recommendation: Re-title homepage around brand + differentiator

findings.title: Noindexed pages included in sitemap
findings.recommendation: Remove /gdpr and /podminky from app/sitemap.ts

findings.title: Mobile homepage above-the-fold shows only splash animation, no H1/CTA/nav
findings.recommendation: Cap animation duration, ensure hero renders immediately

findings.title: Cookie-consent banner overlaps contact form CTA on mobile
findings.recommendation: Reduce banner height, ensure buttons never overlap interactive elements

supplementary_audits.name: Backlinks (foundation-readiness)
supplementary_audits.note: Expected zero-authority state for a 14-week-old domain, not a quality defect

findings.title: 3 real dofollow backlinks verified from delivered client sites
findings.recommendation: None needed, already working

findings.title: Zero local business citations (no GBP, no Firmy.cz)
findings.recommendation: Off-site: register Google Business Profile and Firmy.cz listing
